# A whole carried by lasting parts

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-whole-carried-by-lasting-parts` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-whole-carried-by-lasting-parts.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where from T on a part arises within every d steps and each arising part lasts d steps, the whole is active at every step from T + d on: the converse of a whole's needing its parts' arising, which needs the parts to last.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A part arising within every d consecutive steps from T, each lasting d steps after arising, the whole of some part is active at the step d after every step from T on, so at every step from T + d on. (`Becoming.Web.Whole.persists_of_arising`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.persists_from`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; the parts' arising and lasting as stated; discrete steps.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That actual parts last until the next arises.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
